title: .asd reader for the versions M0 decoded, byte-located errors
description:
## Intent
Read `.asd` files for the versions M0 decoded.

## Scope
- `crates/apricity-daw/src/asd.rs`: `read(bytes, file_name) -> Result<AsdData, SidecarError>`; `AsdData` = WarpMap (+ version). Versions supported exactly as `design/daw-sidecars.md` §Formats lists; unknown version → error naming the found and supported versions and suggesting an `.alc`.
- Bounds-checked parsing: never panics on any input; errors carry the byte offset.
- A property test (proptest or a seeded loop, **bounded to 2 000 cases**) that truncating or flipping bytes of every reference file gives an error or a value, never a panic.

## Verify
`safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw asd` (reference `.asd` scenarios and the malformed ones green).

Commit: `feat(<this id>): read .asd warp markers`.

---
**Toolchain:** every Bash call starts with `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2`; run builds and tests under the watchdog: `safe-run.sh -- <command>` (6 GB / 20 min cap; do not edit it). At most two Rust-building agents at once.
**Protocol:** specs first (write the scenario, watch it fail, then code); keep a running log with `kbs comment` (decisions, problems, attempts, outcomes); paste the tail of **Verify** before asking for review; never commit, push or close (the reviewer does, after re-running Verify). Never write the DAW's brand name anywhere.
